name: Pasteli (Greek Sesame-Honey Bars)

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt, such as Maldon

instructions.primary_message: Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Cut a second sheet of parchment to roughly the same size and set aside.

In a 12-inch skillet, toast sesame seeds and/or sesame seeds and nuts over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly golden and fragrant, 4 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Add honey to now-empty skillet and cook over medium-low heat until bubbling steadily, about 5 minutes.
Add toasted sesame seeds and/or sesame seeds and nuts and cook, stirring frequently, until mixture is fragrant, thickened, and no loose pockets of honey remain, about 3 minutes.

Immediately transfer mixture to prepared sheet and place reserved sheet of parchment on top. Using a rolling pin, bench scraper, or bottom of a small plate, press mixture into an even layer about 1/8- to 1/4-inch thick. Let cool completely at room temperature, about 1 hour.

Once cooled, remove top sheet of parchment. Transfer pasteli, still on bottom sheet of parchment, to a cutting board and cut into 14 to 18 pieces. Serve. Store in an airtight container at room temperature with parchment between layers to prevent sticking.

description: This easy pasteli recipe combines toasted sesame seeds and honey for nutty, chewy Greek sesame bars that require just two main ingredients.
notes: Total time, including resting: 1 hr 15 min.
author: Sharon Brenner
